items.title: 8.9 Mukhtalif equilibrium constants ke darmiyan taalluqat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.9, printed pages 176-179.

blocks.text: Reversible reaction aA + bB se cC + dD ka equilibrium constant chaar qism ki miqdaron se likha ja sakta hai: mol dm-3 mein concentrations Kc = [C]^c [D]^d / [A]^a [B]^b deti hain; gases ke partial pressures Kp = pC^c pD^d / pA^a pB^b; moles ki tadaad Kn = nC^c nD^d / nA^a nB^b; aur mole fractions Kx = xC^c xD^d / xA^a xB^b. Constants Kp = Kc (RT)^delta n, Kp = Kx (P)^delta n aur Kp = Kn (P/N)^delta n se jure hain, jahan R gas constant, T mutlaq darja hararat, P system ka dabao, N reactants aur products ke kul moles, aur delta n balanced muadle mein products aur reactants ke moles ka farq hai. Kaun sa constant bara hai yeh delta n par munhasir hai; agar reactants aur products ke mole numbers barabar hon to delta n = 0 aur Kp = Kc = Kx = Kn, to jo bhi units istemal hon constants ek jaise hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne taalluq Kp = Kn (N)^delta n chhapa hai. Yeh ghalat hai: har gas ka partial pressure p = (n / N) x P hota hai, is liye sahi Kp = Kn (P/N)^delta n hai, jahan P system ka kul dabao aur N kul moles hain. Delta n = 0 ho to (P/N)^0 = 1 aur Kp = Kn.
Sample Problem 8.3: ammonia ke liye Kc se Kp
Sample Problem 8.4: partial pressures se Kp

2SO2(g) + O2(g) se 2SO3(g) ke liye equilibrium partial pressures SO2 1.0 x 10^6 Pa, O2 7.0 x 10^6 Pa aur SO3 8.0 x 10^6 Pa hain. Kp = pSO3^2 / (pSO2^2 x pO2) = (8.0 x 10^6)^2 / ((1.0 x 10^6)^2 x 7.0 x 10^6) = 9.1 x 10^-6 Pa-1.

blocks.prompt: Ammonia synthesis aur PCl5 ke tootne ke liye Kc aur Kp ka muqabla karein. Phir N2 + 3H2 se 2NH3 ke liye 2.0 x 10^7 Pa kul dabao par pN2 = 1.5 x 10^7 Pa aur pH2 = 0.4 x 10^7 Pa ke saath Kp nikalein.
blocks.explanation: Ammonia synthesis ka delta n = -2, to Kp = Kc (RT)^-2 Kc se chhota hai; PCl5 ke tootne ka delta n = +1, to Kp = Kc RT Kc se bara. Ammonia ka partial pressure 2.0 - 1.5 - 0.4 = 0.1 x 10^7 Pa hai. Kp = pNH3^2 / (pN2 x pH2^3) = (1.0 x 10^6)^2 / (1.5 x 10^7 x (4.0 x 10^6)^3) = 1.0 x 10^12 / (9.6 x 10^26) = 1.0 x 10^-15 Pa-2.

items: Kc (concentrations), Kp (partial pressures), Kn (moles), Kx (mole fractions); Kp = Kc (RT)^delta n = Kx P^delta n = Kn (P/N)^delta n; delta n = 0 unhen sab barabar karta hai.
